captureNotes: All four Torque Enable readings remained 0 throughout the capture.
Tilt forward, Body endpoints/front, and Rail endpoints/default had identifiable stable plateaus.
Tilt back reached raw 1829 but did not hold a stable four-second plateau with torque disabled.
Other axes shifted while mechanisms were repositioned, so only the intentionally labeled axis value from each plateau is used.
These are user-defined reference positions and are not yet active firmware limits.
